title: Hope and farewell sound together

captions.physics: Combining new wishes and earlier value
captions.emotions: Feeling farewell to a familiar form

meaning: You can combine a new wish with recognising earlier value and preserve hope while a familiar conversational form still feels like a loss.
text: On your Vishuddha, Temperance in the physical position appears in joining a new wish with recognition of what mattered before. The Star in energy encourages another conversational perspective rather than reducing change to loss alone. Death in emotions brings farewell to a familiar form of communication. You can want another continuation and miss a known rhythm. Hope requires neither declaring the old way unsuccessful nor immediately feeling the new one equally close.

For example, you say you want more spoken calls while acknowledging that the long letters you exchanged will be missed. Both sides sound within one remark rather than compete to count as genuine. **A new perspective does not cancel an earlier form’s value**. You discuss which conversation to try without promising to preserve every old habit entirely. Openness can support while losing a familiar written intonation still brings sadness. This does not prove lack of interest in each other’s voices.

Loss starts pressing if recognising earlier value becomes a duty to change nothing. Combining sides then merely postpones a new answer. The constructive Star helps retain perspective without demanding either complete preservation or instant enthusiasm. You can ask about present wishes and hear caution; hope leaves room for farewell, while sadness does not assign the only permissible form of every future exchange for you both.
